html: 🎉 Our paper PPG as a Bridge: Cross-Device Authentication for Smart Wearables with Photoplethysmography was accepted to IMWUT 2026.
💼 I joined BehaviorAI (founding team) in New York City as a Research Intern.
🏆 I was awarded the Outstanding Undergraduate Thesis.
🏵 I was awarded the Xinya College Academic Excellence Award.
🎉 I will be joining the SciFi Lab at Cornell University as a Ph.D. student in the Department of Information Science.
📩 I have submitted PPG-based Authentication on Smartwatches in Daily Scenarios to IMWUT'25 full paper track.
